concept.description: An idea, data structure or abstraction discussed in software engineering work.

technology.description: A named software system, library, model, database or platform.

tool.description: A program, command, service or component used to do the work.

project.description: A named codebase, product, repository or change such as a pull request.

goal.description: An outcome the work is trying to achieve.

problem.description: A bug, failure, limitation or error encountered.

practice.description: A way of working, process or convention.

constraint.description: A limit or requirement that applies to the work.

metric.description: A measured quantity, score or ranking.
